### Capability Description
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you are proposing.

### Operational Spaceflight / Terrestrial Use Case
Describe the operational context (e.g. Artemis Lunar Base, Lunar Gateway, EVA, or Terrestrial ICU/Aviation).

### Proposed Architectural Approach
Detail how this feature would integrate into AURA-Face (Ocular Engine, Affective Engine, Cockpit HUD, or Cardiovascular Twin).

### Zero-Frame & Privacy Impact
Confirm that the proposed enhancement preserves Zero-Frame Retention and does not persist unencrypted biometric video.
